_comment: Homelab Bridge that imports a Homepage services.yaml (docs/SERVER-SETUP.md#import-from-homepage). Needs PyYAML. From the repo root, against the fake upstreams: python3 server/fake_upstream.py server/recordings/uptime-kuma/normal.json --port 8796 and python3 server/fake_upstream.py server/recordings/gatus/normal.json --port 8797 and python3 server/fake_upstream.py server/recordings/proxmox/normal.json --port 8798, then HOMELAB_TOKENS=<16+ characters> HOMEPAGE_VAR_KUMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:8796 HOMEPAGE_VAR_GATUS_HOST=127.0.0.1:8797 HOMEPAGE_VAR_GATUS_PASSWORD=<anything> HOMEPAGE_VAR_PVE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8798 HOMEPAGE_VAR_PVE_SECRET=<anything> python3 server/reference_server.py --config server/examples/sources-homepage.json. For your own Homepage, set file to its services.yaml and give the bridge the same HOMEPAGE_VAR_ and HOMEPAGE_FILE_ variables as Homepage.
name: bridge homepage
